en: This is a colorized historical postcard showing a street scene with a prominent round or polygonal building in the foreground, which appears to be a public bath or similar facility. The street is broad and lined with young trees, and there are several multi-story residential buildings in the background. There is a church spire visible further back, suggesting a European city setting. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and urban.
